description: This file defines the 'Product' class used within an e-commerce application to represent product details, including descriptions, availability, pricing, images, and related metadata.
external_methods: // methods invoked on the product object (getters/setters)

classes.name: Product
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a product in the catalog, with attributes for descriptions, availability, price, images, and other metadata.

methods.name: getDateAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the product becomes available.

methods.name: setDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the date when the product becomes available.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the core product model object from the associated package.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the core product model object.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of product descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of product descriptions.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Gets the uploaded image file for the product.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the uploaded image file for the product.

methods.name: setProductPrice
methods.description: Sets the product price as a string.

methods.name: getProductPrice
methods.description: Gets the product price as a string.
